boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hamilton College
boards.description: A practical mix of on-campus stops and under-21-safe food runs toward New Hartford and Utica, each backed by directly published late hours.

cards.title: Diner B After Midnight
cards.subtitle: The on-campus option that runs latest
cards.notes: Walk to Beinecke Village on a Thursday, Friday, or Saturday night; confirm academic-calendar service before counting on the 3 a.m. close.
cards.short_summary: Hamilton’s official dining schedule makes Howard Diner the clearest true late-night stop on College Hill.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton lists Howard Diner service until midnight most days, Diner B from midnight to 3 a.m. Thursday and Friday, and Saturday service until 3 a.m.
cards.source_title: Where to Eat - Dining Hours - Hamilton College
cards.access_notes: Current posted hours: Thursday–Friday Diner B Late Night, 12–3 a.m.; Saturday, 3 p.m.–3 a.m. Campus dining schedules may change during breaks.

cards.title: The 10 P.M. Commons Window
cards.subtitle: A late dinner without leaving campus
cards.notes: Use the 9–10 p.m. late-dinner period when you want a campus meal before longer off-campus drives become necessary.
cards.short_summary: Commons provides a predictable final dining-hall hour every night of the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Hamilton’s current dining page lists Late Dinner at Commons Dining Hall from 9 p.m. to 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Where to Eat - Dining Hours - Hamilton College
cards.access_notes: Late Dinner is currently posted for 9–10 p.m. every day; campus dining schedules can be reduced during college breaks.

cards.title: A Near-Midnight Diner Run
cards.subtitle: Sit-down food on North Genesee Street
cards.notes: Check the day-specific listing before driving to Utica; Thursday through Sunday currently offer the strongest near-midnight window.
cards.short_summary: This Utica diner adds a broad breakfast-and-dinner menu when Clinton-area kitchens have closed.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page identifies 180 N Genesee Street in Utica and lists service until 11:58 p.m. Thursday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Denny's at 180 N Genesee St, Utica, NY
cards.access_notes: Posted store hours reach 11:58 p.m. Thursday–Sunday; Monday closes at 10:59 p.m., and Tuesday–Wednesday currently close at 10:59 p.m.

cards.title: Brisket Until 2 A.M.
cards.subtitle: A halal late-night counter in downtown Utica
cards.notes: Make this a deliberate Utica trip rather than a quick village walk, and use the restaurant’s street-parking guidance on arrival.
cards.short_summary: Brooklyn Brisket supplies one of the area’s latest directly documented restaurant schedules.
cards.evidence_claim: Brooklyn Brisket’s official contact page lists its Utica address, describes the restaurant as halal, and posts a 2 a.m. close Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Saturday and noon–midnight Sunday. The business notes street parking nearby.

cards.title: The 2 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: A late New Hartford option on weekends
cards.notes: Go by car and plan on drive-thru service after the dining room closes; Friday and Saturday provide the latest posted window.
cards.short_summary: The New Hartford Taco Bell extends the food map past midnight every night and later on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in New Hartford, NY - 8561 Seneca Turnpike
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the posted dine-in schedule is shorter.

cards.title: Midnight on Seneca Turnpike
cards.subtitle: A consistent seven-night drive-thru fallback
cards.notes: Choose this when predictability matters: the official schedule currently shows the same midnight close every night of the week.
cards.short_summary: Wendy’s offers a straightforward midnight endpoint near the New Hartford shopping corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official New Hartford location page lists both restaurant and drive-thru service from 10 a.m. to midnight seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 8505 Seneca Tpke, New Hartford, NY
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru hours are currently posted as 10 a.m.–midnight daily; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Italian Food Past Midnight
cards.subtitle: A New Hartford sit-down run with a later weekend close
cards.notes: Target Friday or Saturday for the 1 a.m. window, and verify the live hours page before making the drive from College Hill.
cards.short_summary: Carmella’s adds a full-service option to a late-night list otherwise dominated by counters and drive-thrus.
cards.evidence_claim: Carmella’s official hours page lists midnight closing Monday through Thursday and Sunday, with a 1 a.m. close Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Monday–Thursday until midnight, Friday–Saturday until 1 a.m., and Sunday until midnight.

cards.title: Pizza at the Midnight Line
cards.subtitle: A Genesee Street pickup destination
cards.notes: Place a pickup order before the posted midnight close and leave enough driving time from campus for preparation and collection.
cards.short_summary: Palermo provides a named Utica pizza stop with a directly displayed midnight service window.
cards.evidence_claim: Palermo Pizzeria’s direct ordering site identifies the restaurant at 1305 Genesee Street in Utica and displays hours from 10 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: The direct restaurant ordering page currently displays 10 a.m.–midnight; order sufficiently before closing for pickup or delivery.

cards.title: A Midnight Pizza Pickup
cards.subtitle: Chain ordering with a verified Utica storefront
cards.notes: Check the store page before leaving campus, then use advance ordering to avoid arriving at Chenango Road near the closing cutoff.
cards.short_summary: This north Utica Domino’s gives the board another clearly identified midnight pizza destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official storefront page identifies the 2427 Chenango Road location in Utica and currently states that it is open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 2427 Chenango Rd in Utica
cards.access_notes: The official store page currently displays a midnight close; hours vary by location and should be rechecked on the ordering date.

cards.title: Arabian Dinner Until Midnight
cards.subtitle: A Friday-and-Saturday destination on Varick Street
cards.notes: Save this for Friday or Saturday, when the official schedule extends to midnight; other nights end earlier.
cards.short_summary: One Arabian Night contributes a sit-down Arabian menu and a directly documented weekend late window.
cards.evidence_claim: The restaurant’s official site identifies its 706 Varick Street address and lists Friday and Saturday hours from 11 a.m. to midnight.
cards.source_title: One Arabian Night Restaurant - Utica, NY
cards.access_notes: Posted hours reach midnight Friday–Saturday; Monday–Thursday close at 10 p.m. and Sunday closes at 9 p.m.

warnings: Off-campus destinations in New Hartford and Utica require a drive from Hamilton College; verify transportation and same-day hours before leaving.
Several late windows are drive-thru, pickup, weekend-only, or close exactly at midnight. Campus and holiday schedules may vary.
